errata.frozen_text: change any single body slot (input, pre, post or effect) by +1, or flip a Bool slot -> unsatisfiable; every body slot is functionally determined by the pre-state and inputs
errata.defect: Pre slots are inputs of the transition function, not outputs of it. Flipping the pre `reserve` duty presence 0 -> 1 (amount 0) in invoice-open yields the present-zero pre-state. Core accepts that pre-state: scenario_snapshot accepts a registry-named row with the registered identity (runtime.rs:652-659); `requires not liability_present("invoice")` reads only invoice; Liability(reserve) finds the row, keeps before = 0 and writes after = 14 (runtime.rs:796-826). Post state, post duties and every effect are unchanged.
errata.corrected_expectation: In invoice-open with PublicCap(38): flipping pre duty `reserve` present 0 -> 1 is SATISFIABLE (a different valid statement). Every other single change of a body slot (lo limb +1, hi limb +1, Bool flip) is UNSATISFIABLE, including pre `invoice` present 0 -> 1 (requires refuses), pre `reserve`/`invoice` amount +1 while absent (canonicality) and every post/effect/input change.

errata.defect: invoice-open has no UInt slot with hi >= 1 (all values are below 2^64), so the limb mutation cannot be formed there.
